comparison.objective: Orient an arbor plate, support a hub, press out a shaft, and back off; candidate commissions an axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Fixture selection/orientation, coaxial workpiece setup, and press-handle force application versus hex-key alignment, counterholding, collar tuning, locking, and repeated impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Shaft pressed out after correct support setup and press released versus two safe non-bottoming stops with retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both involve industrial force control, but press extraction and dynamic damper tuning are meaningfully different tested abilities. No spec versions or numeric press/alignment limits were supplied.
